title: 第008章 到达龙威集团第009章 寻找乞丐
content_zh:
;;
肖明雄知道是这位救了自己的父亲，所以也不敢得罪，轻声的说道：“原来是秦神医，多谢你救了我的父亲，要不还是先去吃个饭？”
“谢谢，不用了，你先去忙！”秦延军平静的说道。
肖明雄无奈，只好上了车，然后开着车离去。
看到肖明雄离开后，秦延军抬头看向龙威集团：“哇塞！这就是龙威集团，不愧是大师姐管理的公司，这……这么气派。只是可惜我现在还不能进去，还是维持我的乞丐身份吧？”
这时候，一名保安跑了过来：“臭乞丐，赶紧离开这里，这个地方也是你能来的。”
“大哥，我就是路过，马上就走，马上就走。”秦延军知道自己现在还不能证明自己的身份，尤其是还穿着乞丐打扮的衣服，不能够给大师姐抹黑。
保安更加的嚣张，扬了扬手中的塑胶棍：“算你识相，赶紧滚，不然有你好果子吃。”
秦延军没有再理会他，转身就向对面走去。
龙威集团对面环境不错，小广场还带公园，里面长椅长凳不少，所以很多人喜欢在那里逗留，下了班想呼吸一下新鲜空气的，都向那里面走。
需要加班的可以在里面小息一会儿，不加班的自然就回家去了，所以在这里面的人基本上除了加班的高薪工作者，就是到这边来休息的老年人。
秦延军从龙威集团那边过马路，然后来到了这个小广场。
这处小广场也是龙威集团建设时期的配置，因为一个大集团少不了开发布会，所以就有了这处小广场和小公园。
秦延军抬头看了看，然后走了进去，“这里面的人还不少，不如找个地方坐下来休息一会。”
于是乎，小广场不远处，便有一张空着的座椅，便走了过去。看了看四周，然后坐了下来。
“既然休息，那就迷瞪一会吧！”就这样，秦延军就坐在了长椅上，然后闭上了双眼休息。
“嗯！这里还有乞丐。”
“这个乞丐怎么这么奇怪？你看他的衣服，虽然看起来破破烂烂，但是很干净，而且脸还长得那么白净，还是长头发？还玩的那么好，这是怎么回事？”
这时候一对年轻男女路过，仔细打量着秦延军。
两人正说着，又有两名年轻女子，20出头的样子，也走了过来。

“哟！王主管，你们站在这里看什么呢？那么入神？”两名女子当中的其中一人说道。
“小倩，小燕，你们也来呼吸一下新鲜空气呀！这里来了一个乞丐。”王主管热情的同两位美女打着招呼，诉说着看到的秦延军。
叫做小倩的女孩说道：“乞丐，这有什么稀奇的？不管什么时代，都会有乞丐的。看他这样子，应该是饿了，你们还有没有一点同情心？”
小倩说完，便离开了，跟在一起的小燕也跟着离开，留下了那一对青年男女还在原地。
这一切，秦延军都听得清清楚楚，只是不想睁开眼睛来理会他们。
小倩离开后，便来到不远处的一家快餐店，打包了一份盒饭，又拿出200块钱放在了盒饭下面。
小燕问道：“小倩，你这是干什么？同情心泛滥了。”

Xiao Mingxiong knew that it was this father who saved him, so he did not dare to offend him and said softly: "It turns out to be Divine Doctor Qin. Thank you for saving my father. Why don't you go have a meal first?"
"Thank you, no need, you go and do your work first!" Qin Yanjun said calmly.
Xiao Mingxiong had no choice but to get in the car and drive away.
After seeing Xiao Mingxiong leave, Qin Yanjun raised his head and looked at Longwei Group: "Wow! This is Longwei Group. It is worthy of being a company managed by the senior sister. It is... so grand. It's just a pity that I can't go in now, so I should maintain my status as a beggar?"
At this time, a security guard ran over: "Smelly beggar, get out of here quickly, you can come to this place."
"Brother, I'm just passing by. I'll leave right away. I'll leave right now." Qin Yanjun knew that he couldn't prove his identity yet, especially since he was still wearing beggar's clothes, so he couldn't discredit the senior sister.
The security guard became even more arrogant and raised the plastic stick in his hand: "You know what's going on, get out of here, or you'll get the best of you."
Qin Yanjun ignored him and turned around to walk to the opposite side.
The environment opposite Longwei Group is good. There is a small square with a park and a lot of benches inside, so many people like to stay there. Those who want to breathe fresh air after work go there.
Those who need to work overtime can rest there for a while, and those who don’t work overtime will naturally go home. Therefore, the people here are basically not only high-paid workers who work overtime, but also the elderly who come here to rest.
Qin Yanjun crossed the road from Longwei Group and came to this small square.
This small square was also configured during the construction period of Longwei Group. Because a large group is indispensable for holding press conferences, this small square and small park were created.
Qin Yanjun looked up and then walked in, "There are a lot of people here, why not find a place to sit down and rest for a while."
So, there was an empty seat not far from the small square, so he walked over. He looked around and then sat down.
"Since you're resting, let's just stare for a while!" Just like that, Qin Yanjun sat on the bench, then closed his eyes to rest.
"Yeah! There are beggars here."
"Why is this beggar so weird? Look at his clothes, although they look tattered, but they are very clean, and his face is so fair, and he has long hair? He plays so well, what's going on?"
At this time, a young man and woman passed by and looked at Qin Yanjun carefully.
While the two were talking, two more young women, in their early 20s, also came over.
"Hey! Manager Wang, what are you standing here looking at? Are you so entranced?" one of the two women said.
"Xiaoqian, Xiaoyan, come and breathe some fresh air! There is a beggar here." Manager Wang greeted the two beauties enthusiastically and told Qin Yanjun what he saw.
The girl named Xiaoqian said: "Beggars, what's so strange about this? No matter what era, there will be beggars. Looking at him like this, he must be hungry. Do you have any sympathy?"
After Xiaoqian finished speaking, she left, and Xiaoyan who was with her also left, leaving the young man and woman still there.
Qin Yanjun heard all this clearly, but he just didn't want to open his eyes and pay attention to them.
After Xiaoqian left, she went to a fast food restaurant not far away, packed a lunch box, and took out 200 yuan and put it under the lunch box.
Xiaoyan asked: "Xiaoqian, what are you doing? Your sympathy is overflowing."
